verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Mixpanel offers a hosted MCP *server* that exposes its own data/tools to external AI assistants (mixpanel-docs-10, mixpanel-docs-19), which is the reverse of this story — Mixpanel acting as an MCP *client* that plugs in and uses other MCP servers' tools. No evidence indicates Mixpanel can consume external MCP servers as a client.
